notes.title: Arrog is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are so happy to announce that Arrog is finally out on Steam now!

Arrog is an enigmatic puzzle adventure game featuring hand-drawn art and set in a bizarre black-and-white world with color accents. The story of the game is about the journey of a man accepting his death through his dreams. Arrog is a co-production between Hermanos Magia and LEAP Game Studios.

Please notice that it is a very short game, only takes you around 0.5 hours to complete the whole game, but it will be an intense narrative experience that you will remember for a long time. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185700/Arrog/

The Team:


 Developer: LEAP Game Studios, Hermanos Magia
 Publisher: indienova


Key Facts:


 Platform: Steam, Nintendo Switch (later)
 Release Date: July 28th, 2020
 Genre: Point&Click, Puzzle
 Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HKJqLGHU6Yk
 Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A1kAcYVk5A7Rtl4rUnktujtouJgjzUmW?usp=sharing


Features:


 A tale about the journey of a man accepting his death through his dreams.
 A unique black-and-white art style and traditional animations used in a bizarre world.
 An intense 30-minute narrative experience.
 A hand-crafted soundtrack for each section of the game.


Hope you can enjoy it!
